newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Nov trade data to be released on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Nov trade data to be released on Monday.

text.p: Brazil's November trade balance is slated to be released at 1100 local/1300 GMT Monday, the industry and commerce ministry said.
Earlier, local TV Globo television reported the government was poised today to report a roughly $800 million trade deficit in November, down from the record monthly gap of $1.3 billion in October.
The report said exports last month reached $4.112 billion and imports totalled close to $5.0 billion.
Globo cited as its source "a senior member of the government's economic team."
The report could not be independently confirmed.
Brazil's swelling trade deficit has heightened concerns among economists about Brazil's external accounts.
Brazil is expected to post a 1996 trade deficit of between $4.5 billion and $5 billion.
